en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a European city with dense pitched-roof houses in the foreground and a steep rocky hill rising behind them. On top of the hill stands a fortress complex with walls and buildings, while on the right side of the hill there is a prominent clock tower with a large clock face. A long staircase ascends the hillside. The surrounding area features rolling hills in the distance.
